paper_title: Evidence for light-by-light scattering and searches for axion-like particles in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} =$ 5.02 TeV
notes: CMS sets 95% CL limits on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma vs ALP mass (5-90 GeV) from gamma gamma -> a -> gamma gamma in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton (g_agamma = 1/Lambda). However, the numerical exclusion limits are presented only in Fig. 6 (cross section) and Fig. 7 (g_agamma vs m_a plane) as plots; no numerical table of (mass, coupling) pairs is provided in the text, so no reliable data points could be extracted.
